comment: Add tested Vega-Lite semantics, diagnostics, filtered tooltips, recursive views, managed resources, and ranged rendering. Add onRenderCalloutPerDataPoint to GroupedVerticalBarChart, HeatMapChart and PolarChart, onRenderCalloutPerStack to GroupedVerticalBarChart, and identity-preserving onRenderCalloutPerPoint to ScatterChart. Preserve legacy Scatter all-values-at-x callbacks and null-to-default fallback; new point callbacks hide surfaces on null and use native defaults on undefined. Preserve native routing for ordinary and default-typed grouped bars, validate tooltip number format defaults during preflight, preserve raw tooltip fallback in legacy mode, stabilize diagnostics delivery, and use deterministic sampling with bounded full-size data preparation. Use one named SVG container with authored ARIA precedence and explicit semantic failure codes while retaining grouped callout identities across upstream category handling fixes. Centralize native capability, tooltip binding and mode-aware geometry routing contracts; align legacy grouped axis diagnostics with the native renderer. Type evaluator, statistics and resource parsing budget failures at their producers instead of inferring policy from message text, retaining the deprecated transparent compatibility helper. Allow undefined native callback returns in declarations, align composed geometry legend colors with reversed domains, omit continuous fields from categorical legends, reject unsupported ranged continuous color in strict mode with legacy warnings, and preserve tooltip exclusions in accessible labels.
